text: It is too expensive for me.

I understand. A 3 kW rooftop system costs 1,95,000 rupees before the government subsidy of 78,000 rupees, so you pay 1,17,000 rupees. Would you like to schedule a free site survey to see exact savings for your home?
No, it is still too expensive for us.
Would you still like to go ahead with the free site survey so we can check your exact numbers?
Okay, what is the monthly EMI again?
The monthly EMI is available from 2,999 rupees per month for 48 months.
Fine, book the free survey. My name is Kiran, I live in Velachery, Saturday works.
Got it, Kiran. I have noted your area as Velachery and Saturday as your preferred day. Would you like me to go ahead and finalize this booking?
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
